content.text:
You can see which capabilities each model supports in the **Model capability matrix** on the [Models page](https://docs.mistral.ai/models#model-capability-matrix). This matrix lists each model and the API features it supports, with a `yes` indicating support, and includes a list of models that support each feature below the table.

[Model capability matrix](https://docs.mistral.ai/models#model-capability-matrix)
